name: HOC Drive to Client Bot
triggers: No Google Drive trigger, so existing HOC Clients files are not resent
Webhook GET+POST /webhook/hoc-drive-file is the manual kick
action: POST https://api.hoc.agency/api/integrations/drive/poll with the incoming X-N8N-Secret (no $env). Nested request-folder uploads send via Laravel Google changes.watch.
laravel: ops:poll-drive sends a file once; the same Drive modified second is not a revision. Root folders are skipped.
